reader_summary.headline: Jase Auby is the Chief Investment Officer of the Teacher Retirement System of Texas.
reader_summary.overview: Jase Auby is the Chief Investment Officer of the Teacher Retirement System of Texas. TRS manages assets that support the retirement security of over two million public education employees in Texas. Our conversation covers Jase's background and path to TRS, including early working with computers on Wall Street and entrepreneurship.

key_points.text: Jase Auby is the Chief Investment Officer of the Teacher Retirement System of Texas.
TRS manages assets that support the retirement security of over two million public education employees in Texas.
We discuss TRS' organizational structure, competitive advantages, and investment approach and close with Jase's role and accomplishments in his tenure as CIO.
